extracted.name: Grape Jelly Meatballs
extracted.description: These grape jelly meatballs are made in the slow cooker with frozen cocktail meatballs, grape jelly, and chili sauce for an easy party appetizer.
ingredient_lines: 2 (12 ounce) bottles tomato-based chili sauce (such as Heinz®)
instruction_lines: Combine grape jelly, chili sauce, and cayenne pepper in a saucepan over medium-high heat; cook until warm, 5 to 10 minutes.
Place meatballs in a slow cooker and top with grape jelly mixture.
Cook on Low for 3 to 4 hours.
